title: Team Declaration
description: Self-service contract a product team uses to declare its identity and desired S3 buckets. This is the ONLY file a team edits; the platform's generic Terraform root consumes it via yamldecode().

team.description: Team slug, used to derive resource names and the trust policy scope. Must match the directory name teams/<team>/.

owner.description: Contact email for the team, used for tagging/cost allocation and audit trail.

cost_center.description: Finance cost center code, applied as a tag on every resource.

buckets.description: One or more S3 buckets to provision for this team.

name.description: Bucket suffix; final bucket name is <company_prefix>-<team>-<name>, enforced by the Terraform module.

visibility.description: No default is permitted anywhere in the pipeline. Must be explicit.
